# MM-P2-L1-IH02 - Maintenance manual - Hot Forge induction billet heater #2

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-IH02

Scope
- This document covers routine preventive maintenance tasks required to verify operation and safety of Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02). Tasks address mechanical inspection, electrical integrity checks, cooling system verification, and temperature validation to maintain process readiness.

Tools
- Insulated hand tools compatible with induction systems
- Thermal imaging camera or calibrated pyrometer
- Flow meter capable of reading coil cooling water flow
- Lockout/tagout kit and PPE per site requirements

Procedure
- Perform lockout/tagout on EQ-P2-L1-IH02 per SOP-P2-L1-01 before any work on the unit.
- Visually inspect coil assembly and high-current connections for damage, discoloration, or loose fittings. Tighten fittings as required using proper insulated tools.
- Inspect cooling lines, hoses, and fittings for signs of leaks or wear. Replace components that show degradation.
- Verify coil cooling water flow through the coil circuit using the flow meter. Confirm coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) is 55 L/min.
- Energize the unit per SOP-P2-L1-01 and bring a representative billet up to the target process temperature. Confirm the target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) is 1180 °C using a calibrated thermal device.
- Record observed temperatures, flow rates, and any anomalies. If deviations are observed, tag the unit out of service and initiate corrective action referencing ECN-2026-013 and ECN-2026-039.

Acceptance criteria
- No visible damage or loose high-current connections after inspection.
- Cooling system shows no leaks and meets coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) of 55 L/min.
- Billet temperature reaches the target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) of 1180 °C under normal operating conditions.
- All actions and measurements documented and filed according to SOP-P2-L1-01 and referenced ECN documents: ECN-2026-013, ECN-2026-039.
